objects.name: Analytic 2122
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Secure Shell (SSH) or local authentication by an Industrial Control System (ICS) service or operator account from a source Internet Protocol (IP) address outside the approved administrative Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) subnet, or a sudo/su escalation event by an ICS service account that does not normally require interactive privilege escalation, correlated with subsequent execution of ICS engineering tools. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): sudo/su success for Industrial Control Systems (ICS) service account UID without the expected automated invocation pattern

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: syslog:auth

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: IP ranges from which SSH administrative access to ICS Linux assets is authorized.
Inventory of workstations/jump hosts from which ICS-role accounts are authorized to authenticate.
IP ranges from which network device administrative access is authorized.
Time window after anomalous logon within which device-subnet connection is considered correlated, typically 5-15 minutes.
Naming convention or group-membership pattern identifying accounts with engineering, operator, or ICS service roles.
Defined normal working hours for interactive ICS engineering activity, widened for 24/7 shift-based operations.
